title: Enlightening Activity Class 1
speaker: Kanho Chris Burkhart
summary: The teacher invites students to explore the concept of "enlightening activity" or the Bodhisattva, which involves cultivating dynamic balance between action and stillness, encouraging mindful engagement in daily life while maintaining quietness and presence. This practice is seen as a way to transform one's perspective, letting go of attachment to outcomes and embracing compassion and intentional action. By aligning their actions with universal virtue and inter-connectedness, students can cultivate wisdom, kindness, and awareness, leading to greater fulfillment and well-being.
